_comment: What a fuel system can run on (see docs/modding.md, "fuels.json"): heat is what a kg of the mixture gives off
burning, MJ; best_ratio the air to fuel ratio by mass it burns best at; burn_time how long it takes to burn there,
ms, and burn_time_off how much longer at the worst ratio. A fuel system names its fuel ("fuel": "methanol");
one that names none runs on regular. A mod's fuels.json adds fuels or changes one by its id.
